# Marg Vidhyalaya

> A CBSE school built around holistic education: digital classrooms, a well-stocked library, sports and robotics.

Website: https://margvidhyalaya.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 94449 10990

## Key facts
- established 2010
- affiliated to CBSE, New Delhi 2019
- 650 students at Pallikaranai

## Facilities
- CBSE senior secondary
- Digital classrooms
- Library
- Dhruva Sports Academy
- Cricket
- Football
- Basketball
- Yoga
- Archery
- Chess
- Karate, Silambam & Taekwondo
- Skating
- Android Robo robotics
- CCTV across campus

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Marg Vidhyalaya?
No. 6, Prasad Street, Dr. Seethapathy Nagar, Velachery, Chennai 600 042.

### What facilities does Marg Vidhyalaya have?
CBSE senior secondary, Digital classrooms, Library, Dhruva Sports Academy, Cricket, Football, Basketball, Yoga, Archery, Chess, Karate, Silambam & Taekwondo, Skating, Android Robo robotics, CCTV across campus.

### Which board is the school affiliated to?
The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi, since 2019.

### What sports and activities are offered?
Through Dhruva Sports Academy: cricket, football, basketball, yoga, archery, chess, karate and skating. Also Silambam, Taekwondo and the Android Robo robotics program.

### How do I visit Marg Vidhyalaya?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 94449 10990.
